key_insight: β-OPSD generalizes vanilla OPSD by treating the KL anchor as a tunable β regularizer, yielding an optimal policy that geometrically interpolates between a reference policy and a privileged teacher.
engineering_relevance: It preserves the practical efficiency of self-distillation while making optimization more stable and controllable for reasoning-model training.
method: Recast OPSD as a policy-optimization family with β weighting the KL penalty to the reference policy.
Derive a closed-form optimal policy as a geometric mix of reference and teacher distributions.
Approximate the expensive RL objective by distilling token-level logits along the β-selected path, with return-to-go credit assignment.
evidence_signal: The paper reports experiments on mathematical reasoning benchmarks showing β-OPSD consistently improves optimization stability and downstream reasoning performance over vanilla OPSD.
watch_item: Performance depends on correctly tuning β and implementing the token-level logit mixing/return-to-go alignment without introducing training instability.
paper_title: $β$-OPSD: Deriving with Policy Optimization, Training with Self-Distillation
